verified.note: Confirmed: none of the 5 tax schemas existed before this change.
REQ-DT-001 through REQ-DT-010 with GIVEN/WHEN/THEN scenarios present.
Affected Projects, Scope, Risks, Rollback, Open Questions all present.
Decisions D1-D7 and Reuse Analysis present. Status: pr-created.
5 schemas added: TemporaryDifference, TaxLossCarryForward, TaxRateReconciliation, DeferredTaxMovement, TaxProvision. All with required fields, x-openregister-calculations, and x-openregister-rbac.
Account.taxBasisDifferenceCategory added as optional enum with 9 values.
FiscalYear.enactedTaxRates added as optional object/map per jurisdiction. Also added onCloseTaxCalculation lifecycle hook.

All 7 methods present: calculateAllPeriodEnd, detectTemporaryDifferences, compensateLosses, assessRecoverability, applyRateChanges, calculateTaxRateReconciliation, calculateMovement, calculateTaxProvision. Plus private helpers. PHPCS clean.
Wired via FiscalYear lifecycle close hook: onCloseTaxCalculation with action x-openregister-invoke-service calling TaxCalculationService::calculateAllPeriodEnd.

isLossExpired() implements all 3 Wet Vpb regimes. compensateLosses() applies regime check. Tests cover pre-2019 expiry and 2022-onwards no-expiry. 2019-2021 transitional calculation deferred to specialist review.
TaxProvision.linkedVpbReturn FK field declared. calculateTaxProvision() preserves existing linkedVpbReturn on update.
Audit trail inherited automatically by all 5 schemas via OpenRegister audit-trail-immutable. No PHP code required.

Added Bookkeeping > Deferred Taxes menu. Added 6 pages: TemporaryDifferences, TemporaryDifferenceDetail, TaxProvisions, TaxProvisionDetail, TaxLossCarryForwards, TaxLossCarryForwardDetail. All type:index/detail.
TaxRateReconciliation has x-openregister-calculations for statutoryTaxExpense, effectiveTaxExpense, effectiveTaxRate. ETR fully declarative per ADR-031 D2.
All 5 new schemas documented with property tables and reconciliation note.

seed_data.reason: Per design.md: No seed data required. Tax records accumulate from GL on balansdatum via TaxCalculationService invocation.
